name: Aliferous; those with wings
source:
Desperate to prove she has an eye for talent, Juniper approaches a young man named Io to join her for their college's Freshman Art Competition. With Io's skill of toy making, and Juniper's study of fashion, the two set out to make a prototype of a fashion doll. In between, they talk about the concept of art, and find themselves reflecting on their relationship with creation.

[From [url=https://heartsyncproductions.itch.io/aliferous-those-with-wings]itch.io[/url]]
